user.title: Sign in to State Grid
user.description: Uses the Android App API directly without a browser, Android, or Frida. The integration generates a stable local device identity and sends a login SMS.

reauth_confirm.description: The login Token expired. Continue to send a new SMS code while retaining the generated device identity.

error.unknown: State Grid returned an unknown error

abort.already_configured: This State Grid account is already configured
